#  | Technipwn

> --- order: -10

- [Welcome!](https://technionctf.com/welcome.md): Welcome!
- [Past Events](https://technionctf.com/past-events.md): Some past events we've participated in
- [FAQ](https://technionctf.com/faq.md): CTF ("Capture The Flag") is a computer security competition where the objective is to discover "flags" concealed within intentionally vulnerable programs or websites.
- [Kali Linux Installation](https://technionctf.com/kali-installation.md): We recommend installing Kali Linux. Kali Linux is a cybersecurity-focused operating system with many tools that could be useful for solving CTFs.
- [Collaborations](https://technionctf.com/collaborations.md): We would like to thank our partners and sponsors for helping us build and grow our CTF team.

## Beginner workshops

- [Introduction to CTF](https://technionctf.com/beginner-workshops/intro.md): PicoGym - "General Skills" challenges where rating ≥ 75%
- [Web Exploitation](https://technionctf.com/beginner-workshops/web.md): Web Security Academy - apprentice server-side labs
- [Binary Exploitation](https://technionctf.com/beginner-workshops/binary.md): OverTheWire Narnia (0-1)
- [XSS](https://technionctf.com/beginner-workshops/xss.md): XSS Challanges
- [Forensics](https://technionctf.com/beginner-workshops/forensics.md): CTFLearn - forensics challenges where rating ≥ 4.5
- [LLM](https://technionctf.com/beginner-workshops/llm.md): GandalfAI - Reveal the password, and advance through the levels.
- [Cryptography](https://technionctf.com/beginner-workshops/crypto.md): Cryptohack - General - XOR, Data Formats
- [Reverse Engineering](https://technionctf.com/beginner-workshops/reverse.md): MicroCorruption - Debugger reversing

- [Reverse Engineering](https://technionctf.com/advanced-workshops/reverse.md): Challenge! Patch WINMINE so it starts off solved:
- [Binary exploitation (pwn)](https://technionctf.com/advanced-workshops/pwn.md): LiveOverflow's Binary Exploitation series
- [CTF Competition](https://technionctf.com/advanced-workshops/ctf_competition.md): CSP Bypass - Nonce Points: 50
- [Forensics](https://technionctf.com/advanced-workshops/forensics.md)
- [Web Exploitation](https://technionctf.com/advanced-workshops/web.md)
